source: Ashley, Bergman and Eckhoff 2001 (NDSU Dickinson REC); NDSU Sugarbeet Production Guide A1698-26; Wyoming Extension B1063 (five or more years for soil-borne fungi); USDA NASS CDL 2018-2025 on the CSB field sample
